target_customer: Corporate IT and security teams at small to mid-size companies running many SaaS apps
problem: Teams cannot easily see misconfigurations across SaaS apps such as publicly shared documents, missing two factor authentication and weak password settings. Vectrix scans these apps through their APIs and alerts teams.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription (API driven cloud access security broker)

founders.name: Corey Mahan
founders.background_notes: YC page says former Director of Security at Vimeo with over 10 years of security leadership in finance, video and energy in the US and Australia.

founders.name: Alex Dunbrack
founders.background_notes: YC page says former security analyst who built compliance and privacy programs.

founders.name: Matthew Lewis
founders.background_notes: YC page says he moved from offensive security to security engineering.

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires many API integrations with SaaS apps and a rules engine for misconfiguration detection. Standard engineering with security domain expertise, and a small team could ship a basic version.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations take time but can be copied, and competing SSPM vendors were forming in the same period. Little data or network moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cloudflare bought Vectrix in February 2022 to add API driven CASB to its Zero Trust platform and the whole team joined.

market_need_then: Rapid SaaS adoption left IT teams without visibility into configuration risk, a pain described in the company's own YC description with examples like public Google Docs and missing 2FA.

branding.domain_note: Used vectrix.io, not the exact .com; the site returned 403 when fetched.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and practical, with example security questions in its YC description

branding.community_and_virality: Cloudflare TV ran episodes titled This is Vectrix and Building Vectrix after the deal; no pre-deal community found.

brand_strength.rationale: The name resembles Vectrix the logistics startup and the Vectrex console, and no brand press was found beyond acquisition coverage.

outcome_analysis: Vectrix was founded by three security practitioners from Vimeo, PlanGrid and Autodesk and spent about eighteen months as an independent SaaS scanner after YC Summer 2020. Cloudflare bought it in February 2022 to quickly add a CASB product, giving the team a strategic exit before the SaaS security category crowded further. Price was undisclosed and reported funding is only about two million dollars across inconsistent aggregator figures.
notes: Funding reported as 2.2 million dollars in a trade article summary and 2.0 million with an October 2020 date on FundedIQ; both single snippets or aggregators, so no round is recorded. Education not listed on the YC page. Competitor list is empty because dated 2020 sources were not found; later SSPM entrants (Adaptive Shield, AppOmni) appear only on undated directory pages. Cloudflare blog page metadata dates conflict; the YC page and Business Wire URL date the deal to February 10, 2022.
